items.title: Pay invoice for built-in shelf
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag innerhalb eines Monats nach Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug auf unser Konto (IBAN siehe unten).
items.computation: The invoice is a company's own document, not an authority's letter, so there is no statutory deemed-delivery rule; the one-month period runs from the printed invoice date itself (Rechnungsdatum, 30.01.2026), as the letter says 'nach Rechnungsdatum'. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (30 Jan) is not counted, so counting starts 31 Jan 2026. Under § 188 Abs. 2/3 BGB a one-month period ends on the day of the last month bearing the same number as the start day (30 Jan), i.e. 30 Feb — since February has no 30th, it ends on the last day of February, Sat 28 Feb 2026. Since that day is a Saturday, § 193 BGB shifts the deadline to the next business day, Mon 2 Mar 2026. Confirmed by the deadline tool.
